name: Frobisher's search for the Northwest Passage
summary: Looking for a northern way to Cathay, Frobisher sails into a deep bay in Baffin Island he takes for a strait between Asia and America. He brings back an Inuk captive and black rock thought to hold gold; two more voyages mine 1,350 tons of worthless ore.

stops.note: Sights the tip of Greenland, which he takes for Friesland.
Thinks the bay a strait to Asia; five men are lost ashore among the Inuit.
Second and third voyages dig 'gold' ore here.
The ore proves worthless; it ends as road metal.
